Q.5  Which of the following boundary conditions is used in the 2
    DOF planar manipulator example shown below to correctly
      incorporate  the  effect  of  gravity  into  the Newton-Euler
      recursion?





     A) Setting 𝜔0 = 0

     B) Setting 𝑓3 = 0, 𝑛3 = 0

     C) Setting 0𝑣̇0 = 𝑔𝑌̂0

     D) Setting 𝜔̇ 0 = 0

     Answer: C
      Refer to Lecture 13: Newton – Euler’s Equation: Examples
      Slide 5
